g.text: Statutory Juvenile Diversion & Discernment Decision Engine (Republic Act 9344 & DSWD Standards)
START: CICL Case Referred to MSWDO
INPUT: Case Demographics & Psychometric Test Data
• Minor Age at Alleged Offense (A) & Maximum Imposable Penalty
• LMD (14 Items, w_i ∈ {1..6}) | IVJ (54 Items, δ_j ∈ {0,1}) | CFC & FFC Checklists
STAGE 2 & 3: RISK TRIAGE & TARGETED REHABILITATION PROGRAM HARVESTER
KEY ALGORITHM RULES & STATUTORY DECISION MATRIX (RA 9344)
• 15 < A < 18 & Δ=0: Exempt from criminal responsibility
